newsitem.title: USA: Louis Dreyfus files to register stock sale.
newsitem.headline: Louis Dreyfus files to register stock sale.

text.p: Louis Dreyfus Natural Gas Corp said Friday it filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission relating to the sale by the company of 2.75 million shares of common stock.

The registration statement also covers 2.75 million shares to be sold by the company's majority shareholder, S.A. Louis Dreyfus et Cie, plus an additional 825,000 shares which may be sold by pursuant to an underwriters' over-allotment option.
The company said its proceeds will initially be used to pay down bank debt and then to pursue additional oil and gas drilling and acquisition activities.

The secondary offering will reduce the majority shareholders stake to about 54 percent of the company's outstanding stock from about 74 percent, spokesman Kevin White said. S.A. Louis Dreyfus et Cie now holds 20.6 million Louis Dreyfus Natural Gas shares.
Managing underwriters for the offering will be Salomon Brothers Inc; Credit Suisse First Boston Corporation; Howard, Weil, Labouisse, Friedrichs Inc; and Morgan Stanley & Co Inc.
